name: MapLore Magic (Development Features for HexaGrid)
description: Transform Your Images into Mesmerizing Hexagon Grids

paragraphs: Welcome to MapLore Magic, the ultimate tool for transforming your images into mesmerizing artworks! Well, this is a test project for HexaGrid. It has some nice features that did not make it into the final version of the program. The intention was to do a full conversion, but the limitation on Negative Prompts is what killed this approach. It does not consistently render table top maps.. but it can do a lot!
features: Fun and Easy to Use: With an intuitive interface and real-time previews, creating unique images has never been this fun!
Endless Creativity: Unleash your creativity with endless customization options and see your images transform in unique ways.
Advanced AI Models: Leverage advanced AI models and LoRA weights for high-quality image generation and customization.
